name: Bank Sumsel Babel Run 2026
short_description: Bank Sumsel Babel Run 2026 is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Jakabaring Sport City in Palembang, over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon.
ai_summary: Bank Sumsel Babel Run 2026 (BSB Run 2026) marks the 69th anniversary of Bank Sumsel Babel, under the theme "Move Grow Beyond". It is held at Jakabaring Sport City in Palembang on Sunday 6 December 2026, with 5 km, 10 km and half marathon categories; the organiser names the category "Half Marathon" without stating a distance, so 21.1 km is inferred. The official site is run by IM Road Runner.

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times and age limits at Bank Sumsel Babel Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The cut-offs are 1 hour 15 minutes for the 5 km, 2 hours for the 10 km and 4 hours for the half marathon. The 5 km is open from age 13, and the 10 km and half marathon to ages 17 to 70; entry is limited to Indonesian citizens.

faqs.question: Has the date of Bank Sumsel Babel Run 2026 changed?
faqs.answer: Yes. It was listed for Sunday 1 November 2026, but the official site now counts down to Sunday 6 December 2026 at 06:00 WIB. Check the organiser's channels for the updated race-pack collection dates before you travel.
